items.t: A 67-Year-Old With $750,000 in Pfizer, Altria and Realty Income Collects $3,575 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Altria and Realty Income pays $42,905 a year in dividends at current prices, or $3,594 a month. Altria and Realty Income cover their dividends with room to spare, at 78% of free cash flow and 75% of AFFO.

items.t: Pfizer Just Raised Its 2026 Revenue Forecast by $1.5 Billion. Is the High-Yield Stock a Buy Right Now?
items.sum: Pfizer isn't out of the woods yet, but it is proving it remains a well-run drugmaker.

items.t: A Record-High Dividend Yield Can Be a Warning Sign. Just Ask Pfizer
items.sum: A huge yield looks like a bargain until the payout gets cut. Six dividend stocks just hit record yields against their own history, and only some of them can afford what they pay shareholders.

items.t: Pfizer Stock Down 6% Post Q3 Earnings: Time to Buy, Hold or Exit?
items.sum: PFE shares fell despite the company beating Q3 estimates and raising guidance. Explore its growth drivers, pipeline potential, patent risks & attractive valuation.

items.t: A $400,000 Portfolio in UPS, Enterprise Products and Pfizer Pays $23,577 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA $400,000 portfolio split evenly across UPS, Enterprise Products Partners and Pfizer pays about $1,960 a month in dividends at today’s prices. Enterprise Products Partners has the most room behind its payout, with distributable cash flow at 1.

items.t: Pfizer: $1.5bn Of Blackstone Funding Doesn't Make Berobenatide A Winning Obesity Drug
items.sum: Pfizer partners with Blackstone, securing up to $1.5bn in funding for berobenatide, a potential first-in-class monthly GLP-1 agonist for obesity.
